Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 113. Category: feat. Majin.

You gain the full strength of a creature within you that
you absorb. When you would absorb a creature, you
assimilate them entirely into you to gain the entirety of
what you did not access. You gain all Transformation
that the creature has and while you have a creature
assimilated, you have the Fusion Tag. You may only
choose one creature to Assimilate within you.
